name: NotificationClientContract
requirements: in-app notification inbox with cursor pagination
unread count derived from canonical notification records
per-user notification category and channel preferences
channel-specific delivery status separate from notification read state
validated internal deep-link targets only; no arbitrary external URLs
Appwrite Realtime subscription scoped to the authenticated user and authorized notification records
quiet hours and locale-aware delivery where the selected provider contract supports them
device registration only when an approved push provider and device-token lifecycle contract exist
retry and failure state visibility for authorized operations staff
reduced payload and no secrets or protected content in push previews
accessibility labels, keyboard operation, reduced-motion support, and responsive layouts
